limitations: These are planned science requirements in a March 2026 presentation, not completed Moon burns or measured outcomes.
Each planned test requires its own initial atmosphere; source specifies venting to vacuum between tests.
The source does not explicitly state a mole/volume basis for oxygen percentages.
The source says both sides of the fabric sheet are exposed; geometry is per sheet.
This 2026 fabric concept differs from the older SIBAL/PMMA concept; do not silently pool historical design requirements as measurements.

LUCI samples 30 s after ignition. Left: Edge view of SIBAL fabric (cotton-fiberglass blend) burning downward in Lunar-g 30 s
after ignition. The flame spread for over a minute. Right:4-mm-diameter PMMA rod burning upward in air in Lunar-g, 30 s
after ignition. The flame eventually grows to engulf the entire rod.
